description: PAID: replace the contents of a stored file you own, keeping its id, with a fresh plan term. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

contentBase64.description: The replacement bytes, base64-encoded. Decoded size must fit the plan.

id.description: The object id returned when it was bought.

label.description: Optional caller-chosen label, up to 256 characters, no control characters.

plan.description: Storage plan; it sets both the size limit and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

name: storage_replace
title: Replace a stored object (paid, x402)
